title: HOA Fee Drift Monthly Trend
dataSources: Mortgage-rate snapshots (`mortgage:rate`), property-listing and Zestimate data (`property:listing`), HOA fees (`hoa:fee`), property-tax installments (`propertytax:installment`), home-buying milestones (`homebuying:milestone`).
app: Mortgage-rate watchers, Zestimate exports, HOA-fee logs, and property-tax installment trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and personal checklists.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hoa:fee
| timechart span=1mon avg(fee_amount_usd) as avg_metric
description: Trends HOA fee in dollars for hoa fee drift over time so gradual drift is obvious.
value: Property decisions usually move slowly, which makes month-level trending more useful than isolated snapshots.
implementation: Retain enough history to compare current conditions with earlier seasons or search phases.
visualization: Line chart of monthly average HOA fee in dollars.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how hoa fee drift is moving over time.
